fields.name: Orleans Reminder Storage
fields.responsibility: Stores Orleans reminder rows across a configured shard set — upserting and removing a grain's reminder, reading one row, all of a grain's rows, or every row whose hash falls in a requested range — and publishes the reminder service to a silo builder. It also holds the reminder periods it can actually honour and polices the silo's reminder configuration against them as the silo starts: a negative minimum period is refused outright, a period shorter than the supported floor is admitted with a warning, so a misconfiguration surfaces before reminders are silently missed at runtime. Spreading reminders over a shard set rather than one database is what distinguishes it from the cluster tables and is why it is configured against a shard set.
